newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks seen mixed on fear of unrest.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks seen mixed on fear of unrest.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed up on Sunday amid a volatile trade, and dealers said the sentiment would remain mixed on Monday because of political uncertainty in the central province of Punjab.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index rose 9.61 points, or 0.66 percent, to end at 1,461.01. Losers led gainers 134 to 88. Turnover fell to 25.11 million shares from 42.23 million in the previous session.
The Lahore High Court ruling reinstating ousted Punjab chief minister Manzoor Ahmad Wattoo is likely to lead to a bitter power struggle that may keep the sentiment mixed, dealers said.
Askari Bank rose 0.30 to 22.55 rupees, Muslim Commercial Bank 0.25 to 38.25, Dewan Salman Fibre 2.95 to 35.40 and Pakistan Synthetic 0.75 to 13.50.
Hub Power Co rose 0.50 to 34.35 and Pakistan State Oil 1.0 to 347. PTCL finished steady at 32.40. Engro Chemical rose 1.50 to 138.50 and Fauji Fertilizer rose 2.75 to 80.75.
